_about: 2-18 (R1 fix 1, re-authored in steps 140 and 144, again on the wave 3a timing build, R3 round 1): the door room is held by
antiportal_1237 (124.8 px round anti_portal_agent_ent_1238 at (88, 90)); its agent dies to a shot that comes within 22.4 of it, which
deletes the ring and lets a portal open in the room; the door is door_lift_1146, up while the player (or the crate) stands on button_1148.
The wave-2 route could not be kept: its portal hop to the lift's foot is an arc over block00, and with the decoded walk the air keeps only
0.86 of the x velocity a tick (at most 14.7 px of drift from 144 u/s), which no exit outside antiportal_1138 (115.2 px round (461, 212)) can use; its
fall-launch to (253.8, 43.5) and the 0.4 px kill window need the same drift, and the crate on the button was timed to the carranca's 180-tick stride.

at y 70.6 from ~588. Left from 595: over the post single_block_1208 and off its edge on ~631, down at (396.7, 138.5) on the upper floor by 642.
The barrel on the carranca is what blocks the way to the agent, and a portal near it is in the ring, so the carranca's own fireball removes it: a pair
